# Locale review sheet: Hmoob (hmn)

<!-- Generated by tools/i18n/build-locale-review.mjs from the locale files. Do not edit by hand. -->

Status: ai-draft. Reviewed by: nobody yet. Reviewed on: not yet.
HTML language tag: `hmn`. Community language (no USCIS civics translation was used).

## How to review

Read each row. For each translation, check that it says the same thing as the English, in words a speaker of this language would use. Mark anything stiff, wrong or unnatural. The English column is the source of truth.
To record a review, fill `reviewedBy` and `reviewedOn` in `_meta` of `src/i18n/locales/hmn.json` and set `source` to `human-reviewed`. The AI label then disappears for this language.

## Lines marked ⚠ (meaning differs a little)

- `aiNotice.text`: "authoritative" is rendered as "official" (raug cai): close, slightly weaker.
- `intro.privacy`: "fictional profile" is rendered as "made-up model" (tus qauv tsim los). The word qauv (pattern, model) may not be the natural word for a profile. Needs a Hmong reader.
- `n400.sample.note`: Same word (qauv) for the made-up profile.
- `help.setup.2`: Same word (qauv) for the profiles.
- `intro.profile.legend`: Same word (qauv) for "profile".
- `intro.profile.help`: Same word (qauv) for "profile".
- `common.fictional`: Same word (qauv) for "profile".
- `header.about`: "Txog peb thiab ceeb toom" reads as "About us and warning", not "About & disclaimer". Needs a Hmong reader.
- `compare.setting`: "in order" now "ib lo tom qab ib lo" (one word after another) and "may be missing" "poob tau" (may fall out). Still needs a Hmong reader.
- `voice.consent.text`: "Say" is the plain verb for speaking, and "language" (lus) stands in for "words". Needs a Hmong reader.
- `compare.setting.writing`: "punctuation" is rendered as "stopping marks" (cov cim nres) and "spelling" as "writing". Needs a Hmong reader.
- `coach.notice.text`: "fictional" is "not real" and "on/off" is "open/closed" (qhib, kaw). Needs a Hmong reader.
- `coach.privacy`: "salted code" is rendered as "secret number" (lej zais). Needs a Hmong reader.
